goal.what: Whoever builds or changes turn, a person or an AI, derives each part's specification from this document and implements it on the same framework and principles, so turn gives the person the UX in dev/turn/ux.md whatever the implementation.
grounds: architecture.json purpose
dev/turn/ux.md: O1

decisions.what: How does turn deliver its UX, in a few sentences?
decisions.decided: A work is made from its kind's template and the person's answers by four roles, planner, designer, builder and evaluator, the evaluator never seeing the design; lane holds their order and limits.
grounds: .rn/20261013-rebuild/turn-rebuild.md, Concept and Roles

decisions.what: What makes a new kind cost only a template?
decisions.decided: Principle: one way for every kind; the roles hold no rule of any kind.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md: "How turn moves a work toward its goal is the same for every kind, so a new kind needs only a template."

decisions.what: What must be given before a run?
decisions.decided: Principle: nothing is needed beforehand; planner asks the kind, designer the purpose, and a caller's settled points count as decided.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md, What turn takes and gives

decisions.what: How does the evaluator judge?
decisions.decided: Principles: it uses the work as its user would, and never sees the design.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md, evaluator 1 and Use and answer

decisions.what: Who asks the person what, and who changes the design?
decisions.decided: Principle: one asker for each thing; planner the kind and template, designer the purpose and design, designer alone changing it.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md: "designer alone changes the design and alone asks the user about it"

decisions.what: In what order are the decisions made, and where kept?
decisions.decided: Principle: decided from the purpose down, in builds_on order, kept in a design tree.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md, Design tree and designer 2-4

decisions.what: How are content and wording kept apart?
decisions.decided: Principle: what the work says before how it says it; the content phase on the kind's questions, then the refactoring phase on the included templates' questions.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md, Flow 1 and 2 (Fowler, Refactoring)

decisions.what: Where is a more mended?
decisions.decided: Principle: a more is mended at its decision, never added onto the work; one that comes back after its decision was remade goes to the person.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md, designer 7

decisions.what: How does each role carry on?
decisions.decided: Principle: each role starts fresh at each move and works from the run's files.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md, Flow: "start fresh at each move and carry on from the run's files"

decisions.what: Who tells the phase, and why not the files?
decisions.decided: Principle: turn:up tells the phase from the role that last ended and its answer, as a point designer keeps leaves the files as they were.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md, Flow 2: "The orchestrator tells the phase from the role that last ended and its answer"

decisions.what: What holds the order and limits, and how does turn use other plugins?
decisions.decided: Principles: lane holds the order and the limits, turn's scripts check only what no lane holds; turn knows lane and a caller only by what they document.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md, Files: "A script checks only what no lane holds"
plugins/lane/README.md: the check script and the flow

decisions.what: Which user stories carry the UX's steps?
decisions.decided: Five: ask and confirm the kind; approve a new kind's purpose, format and checklist; answer the purpose and points and approve the design; get the work once every question is good, carrying the step where turn writes and checks; a plugin's step starting turn:up.
grounds: dev/turn/ux.md:20-42: each message falls in one story; the caller's story carries a person reaching turn through rn, turn-rebuild.md, User and purpose

decisions.what: Which roles and stores, each with its technology?
decisions.decided: turn:up and four roles as Markdown subagents; check.py, wait.py and the items adapter as Python 3.9 stdlib scripts; lane's check script; stores Templates, Run files, Forms and the work.
grounds: dev/turn/components.svg, read as source
turn-code b37cf1ac: plugins/turn/scripts/check.py, tree.py, answers.py, wait.py

decisions.what: What does each role alone decide?
decisions.decided: turn:up the run; planner the template; designer each point of the design; builder the small points and the wording, returning open points; evaluator each answer; check.py what no lane holds; the items adapter the question IDs; the main conversation relays each ask, wait.py holding the role.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md, Roles; only the main conversation can ask the person

decisions.what: Which choices of the components would a builder question?
decisions.decided: turn:up a subagent, as lane lays a flow only on one; started in the background so the main conversation relays asks; builder and evaluator serve both phases; a refactoring more goes back to builder.
grounds: plugins/lane/README.md:18-19: the orchestrator of a flow must be a subagent

decisions.what: How do the data join?
decisions.decided: The data model: Template has Format and Questions and includes Templates; Design tree has Purpose and Decisions, each serving Questions and building on Decisions; Answers hold an Answer for each Question.
grounds: dev/turn/data-model.svg, read as source; turn-rebuild.md, Files

decisions.what: What sequence does each story follow?
decisions.decided: One Mermaid sequence for each story, the participants named as in Components, lane's check script among them as Check script.
grounds: one name for one thing: plugins/lane/README.md calls it the check script

decisions.what: Where does each part run and keep its files?
decisions.decided: On the person's computer in Claude Code; runs in .turn/<yyyymmdd>-<name>/ and kept templates in .turn/templates/, in the folder Claude Code runs in, not a repository; lane's check script in turn's own folder.
grounds: turn needs no repository: a press release is made outside one
dev/turn/deployment.svg drew that folder as The repository [git working folder], against the text; it is redrawn as the folder Claude Code runs in

decisions.what: Which tests cover each unit, and when do they pass?
decisions.decided: Agents by trials of one role and of the four under lane's flow; scripts by unittest, Cosmic Ray and Hypothesis; templates by check.py; the whole by a trial of each story; trials on Opus pass in three runs of three.
grounds: dev/architecture.md#test
what an AI does varies from run to run

decisions.what: Why are agents and scripts weighed heaviest?
decisions.decided: A stray role or a lax check gives the person a work that misses its purpose, or asks them what they need not decide.
grounds: dev/turn/ux.md KR1.1, KR1.2

decisions.what: What keeps the document true while a role changes inside?
decisions.decided: Lines say responsibilities, relations and choices with reasons; steps and file fields stay in the prompts and the forms.
grounds: architecture.json Q15
